in_sanskrit.name: Palanisamy
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector of the Temple
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Palanisamy एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Palanisamy is a Tamil name derived from the Tamil words 'Palani', which means mountain, and 'Samy', which means protector or preserver. This name is often given to boys in honor of the Hindu deity Murugan, also known as Subramanya or Kartikeya, who is believed to protect temples and is the god of war, healing, and knowledge.
